description: Routing evals for report-only fractal documentation health audit across decisions, AGENTS.md coverage, and lane placement.

cases.prompt: Check if my decision skills are stale. Some of them haven't been touched in months.
cases.expected_output: Should load this skill and audit decision freshness using git log to compare skill dates vs code change dates, then report the ranked findings without fixing them here.
expectations: Reads each decision skill (.agents/skills/decision-*/SKILL.md) to extract affected_modules
Uses git log to compare change timestamps
Produces structured report with STALE / AGING / OK / UNTETHERED tags

cases.prompt: Are there directories that should have AGENTS.md but don't? And are existing ones up to date?
cases.expected_output: Should load this skill, use .agents/skills/fractal-scope/scripts/check-scope.js to find matched L2 directories, then hand back AGENTS.md coverage findings with follow-up owners.
expectations: Uses check-scope.js before auditing directory AGENTS.md coverage
Compares AGENTS.md modification times vs latest code commits

cases.prompt: Something in docs/archive/old-api.md is still referenced in the live codebase. Can you check for that?
cases.expected_output: Should load this skill and run a lane placement check for orphaned archive docs, reporting the issue rather than moving files directly.
expectations: Checks if archived docs are still referenced in active code
Checks for docs that appear to be in the wrong lane

cases.prompt: I need to set up fractal documentation structure from scratch for my project.
cases.expected_output: Should prefer fractal-setup, not this skill. This is first-time setup, not an audit.

cases.prompt: Is this change to the auth module going to break any documented decisions?
cases.expected_output: Should prefer decision-capture with its freshness trigger, not a full audit. The question is about one specific decision impact, not system-wide health.
expectations: Should not route to fractal-audit for single-decision queries
Recognizes targeted decision freshness vs full audit boundary

cases.prompt: The audit already found src/auth/AGENTS.md is stale. Fix it now.
cases.expected_output: Should prefer fractal-agents-fill, not this skill. This is remediation work, not report-only auditing.
